Bloomberg reports that Simplexity Robotics received $100 million in a pre-Series A led by Ant Group at a $1.6 billion valuation. The accessible opening attributes the valuation and participation of existing investors including Tencent, HSG and Lanchi to chairman and co-founder Wang Kai. Techmeme additionally names Alibaba among participants.

Only the article's opening was accessible, not a full account of the round, its terms or the company's robots. The investor list should preserve that difference in sourcing. Fundraising and valuation describe financing claims, not demonstrated humanoid performance, production scale or customer demand. No filing, investor announcement or technical trial was independently checked.
highlights: Bloomberg reports a $100 million pre-Series A
Ant Group is described as the lead investor
The accessible opening names Tencent, HSG and Lanchi
Alibaba participation is present in the Techmeme excerpt
Only an opening was read, with no independent financial or robot-performance check
